requirements.title: Vulkan Context Initialization
requirements.description: The system shall provide automatic Vulkan instance and device creation with sensible defaults while allowing advanced users to customize device selection and feature requirements.
requirements.rationale: Foundation for all rendering operations. Must work out-of-box for intermediate users while exposing control for experts.
acceptanceCriteria: VulkanContext initializes with zero configuration on supported hardware
Device selection can be overridden programmatically
Required Vulkan extensions are validated at startup
Clear error messages when initialization fails

requirements.title: Command Buffer Management
requirements.description: The system shall manage Vulkan command buffer allocation, recording, and submission with automatic synchronization and frame pacing.
requirements.rationale: Critical for correct GPU command execution. Hides complexity of Vulkan synchronization from users.
acceptanceCriteria: Command buffers are pooled and reused efficiently
Users can access raw command buffers when needed

requirements.title: GPU Memory Allocation
requirements.description: The system shall provide efficient GPU memory allocation for buffers and images with automatic memory type selection and defragmentation support.
requirements.rationale: Proper memory management is critical for performance and stability.
acceptanceCriteria: Memory allocation uses VMA or equivalent allocator
Memory usage can be queried and monitored

requirements.title: GLTF 2.0 Model Loading
requirements.description: The system shall load GLTF 2.0 and GLB files with full support for meshes, materials, textures, and scene hierarchy.
requirements.rationale: GLTF is the standard 3D interchange format. Full support enables interoperability with all major 3D tools.
acceptanceCriteria: Validate GLTF structure and report errors

requirements.title: Skeletal Animation Support
requirements.description: The system shall support skeletal animation including bone hierarchies, skinning, and animation playback from GLTF files.
requirements.rationale: Character animation is essential for games and interactive applications.
acceptanceCriteria: Parse GLTF skin and joint data
Support for multiple animations per model

requirements.title: Morph Target Animation
requirements.description: The system shall support morph target (blend shape) animation for facial expressions and mesh deformation.
requirements.rationale: Morph targets enable facial animation and soft-body deformation effects.
acceptanceCriteria: Blend between morph targets with weights

requirements.title: PBR Material Rendering
requirements.description: The system shall render physically-based materials using the metallic-roughness workflow with support for all standard PBR texture maps.
requirements.rationale: PBR is the industry standard for realistic material rendering. Essential for professional-quality output.
acceptanceCriteria: Support baseColor, metallic, roughness, normal, occlusion, emissive maps
Match Khronos GLTF sample viewer output
Support both textured and constant material values

requirements.title: Image-Based Lighting
requirements.description: The system shall support image-based lighting (IBL) using environment maps for realistic ambient lighting and reflections.
requirements.rationale: IBL provides realistic environment lighting essential for photorealistic rendering.

requirements.title: Transparency Rendering
requirements.description: The system shall support both alpha masking and alpha blending for transparent materials with correct sorting.
requirements.rationale: Transparency is required for glass, foliage, and many common materials.
requirements.source: Codebase analysis - ALPHA_MASK, ALPHA_BLEND shader features
acceptanceCriteria: Alpha mask with configurable cutoff threshold
Alpha blending with correct depth sorting
Separate render passes for opaque and transparent

requirements.title: Advanced Material Extensions
requirements.description: The system shall support GLTF material extensions including clearcoat and transmission for advanced material effects.
requirements.rationale: Extensions like clearcoat and transmission enable car paint, glass, and other advanced materials.
requirements.source: Codebase analysis - CLEARCOAT, TRANSMISSION shader features
acceptanceCriteria: Correct layering of clearcoat over base material

requirements.title: URI-Based Asset Resolution
requirements.description: The system shall resolve assets using URI schemes (asset://, pak://) providing a unified interface for filesystem and packaged assets.
requirements.rationale: URI-based loading enables flexible asset deployment without code changes between development and production.
requirements.source: Codebase analysis - rsc module URI schemes
acceptanceCriteria: pak:// resolves to PAK archive contents
Consistent API regardless of asset source

requirements.title: PAK Archive Support
requirements.description: The system shall support loading assets from PAK archive files for efficient packaged deployment.
requirements.rationale: PAK archives enable single-file distribution and faster loading from fewer filesystem operations.

requirements.title: Texture Atlasing
requirements.description: The system shall support automatic texture atlasing to pack multiple PBR textures into shared atlases for GPU memory optimization.
requirements.rationale: Atlasing reduces texture binding overhead and enables batch rendering of diverse materials.
acceptanceCriteria: Fallback to individual textures when needed

requirements.title: Cryo Scene Protocol Integration
requirements.description: The system shall receive and process scene configuration from Cryo protocol messages, enabling external scene control via RuntimeContext.
requirements.rationale: Core integration point for Cryo ecosystem. Enables Cryo Studio and other tools to control CoreGFX scenes.
acceptanceCriteria: Handle SceneLoadRequest for dynamic scene loading
Error feedback when scene configuration fails

requirements.title: Cryo Render Command Protocol
requirements.description: The system shall accept render commands from Cryo protocol for camera updates, material overrides, and render state control.
requirements.rationale: Enables external applications to control rendering without direct API coupling.
acceptanceCriteria: Support MaterialOverride for runtime material changes
Commands applied within same frame when possible

requirements.title: Cryo Asset Protocol Integration
requirements.description: The system shall load assets on demand via Cryo asset protocol requests, integrating with the URI-based asset resolution system.
requirements.rationale: Enables Cryo tools to trigger asset loading without direct filesystem access.

requirements.title: Cryo Frame Feedback Protocol
requirements.description: The system shall send frame completion, render statistics, and optional framebuffer data back to Cryo via the frame protocol.
requirements.rationale: Enables monitoring, synchronization, and remote rendering use cases.
acceptanceCriteria: Send FrameComplete after each rendered frame
Include RenderStats with timing and draw call counts
Optional FrameBuffer capture for remote viewing

requirements.title: Bidirectional Cryo API Service
requirements.description: The system shall provide a bidirectional API service for request/response and event notification patterns with Cryo ecosystem.
requirements.rationale: Central integration point for complex interactions beyond simple commands.

requirements.title: Windows Platform Support
requirements.description: The system shall support Windows desktop with native window creation and Vulkan surface integration.
requirements.rationale: Windows is the primary development and deployment target.
requirements.source: Codebase analysis - platform module (stable for Windows)
acceptanceCriteria: Handle window resize and DPI changes

requirements.title: Android Platform Support
requirements.description: The system shall support Android with native activity integration and Vulkan surface creation.
requirements.rationale: Mobile deployment enables broader reach. Currently partial implementation.

requirements.title: Headless Rendering Mode
requirements.description: The system shall support headless rendering without a display for server-side rendering and testing.
requirements.rationale: Essential for CI/CD, server rendering, and Cryo integration testing.
requirements.source: Codebase analysis - platform module headless mode
acceptanceCriteria: No display or window system required

requirements.title: Frame Rate Performance
requirements.description: The system shall maintain 60fps rendering for typical scenes with PBR materials and skeletal animation.
requirements.rationale: Consistent frame rate is essential for interactive applications and games.
acceptanceCriteria: Frame time variance < 2ms for smooth animation
GPU utilization optimized for target hardware

requirements.title: Memory Efficiency
requirements.description: The system shall manage GPU and CPU memory efficiently with predictable allocation patterns and leak prevention.
requirements.rationale: Memory leaks and fragmentation cause crashes and degraded performance over time.
acceptanceCriteria: No memory leaks in long-running sessions
GPU memory usage queryable at runtime

requirements.title: Vulkan Version Compatibility
requirements.description: The system shall support Vulkan 1.1+ with optional use of 1.2/1.3 features when available.
requirements.rationale: Broad hardware support while enabling modern features on capable hardware.

requirements.title: C++17 Standard Compliance
requirements.description: The system shall be fully compliant with C++17 standard for broad compiler support.
requirements.rationale: C++17 provides modern features while maintaining compatibility with common toolchains.
acceptanceCriteria: No C++20 features in public headers

requirements.title: SceneConfig Protocol Handler
requirements.description: The system shall process SceneConfig messages from the cryo.scene protocol domain and apply the configuration to RuntimeContext.
requirements.rationale: Core requirement for Cryo ecosystem integration - enables external scene control.
acceptanceCriteria: Return error response for invalid config
